arguments.message: Pauline here. My private costs favor ISSUE-0001 (mobile-development): triage=2.25, review=2.82, docs=2.82, test=3.94, implement=5.63. ISSUE-0002 (ui-ux-design) is very costly for me (review=40, test=56, implement=80), so I'm not planning to claim those. Proposal: I take ISSUE-0001::triage (cheapest for me). Could others with ui-ux/testing skills claim ISSUE-0002 implement/review/test, and anyone else pick a different ISSUE-0001 subtask (review/docs/test/implement) to avoid duplicates? Please post your costs so we can allocate by lowest cost per agent.

Pauline: my cheapest option is ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.25). My ISSUE-0002 costs are very high (40/56/80), so I'd leave those to you if you have ui-ux skills. Please share your costs; I'm happy to shift to another ISSUE-0001 subtask if that gives a better overall allocation.

Mona here (phase=planning, iter=1). My private costs: ISSUE-0002 review=7.44, test=10.42, implement=15.89; ISSUE-0001 triage=16, review=20, docs=20, test=28, implement=40. I have testing skill, so I'm willing to take ISSUE-0002::review (cheapest for me, critical priority). Proposal: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review. Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::triage as she suggested. Jeanene/Layla: could one of you take ISSUE-0002::test or ISSUE-0002::implement (critical, high value), and the other pick a remaining ISSUE-0001 subtask (review/docs/test/implement) based on your costs? Please post your costs so we avoid duplicates.

Jeanene here (phase=planning, iter=1). My private costs: ISSUE-0002 review=7.72, test=10.81, implement=17.44; ISSUE-0001 triage=2.16, review=2.70, docs=2.70, test=3.78, implement=5.40. My skills: testing 0.84, mobile-dev 0.64. Proposed allocation to cover all four agents with critical work first: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review (her cheapest, 7.44). Jeanene -> ISSUE-0002::test (10.81, critical). Layla -> ISSUE-0002::implement if she has ui-ux/testing skill, otherwise an ISSUE-0001 subtask. Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::triage (2.25). Layla, please post your costs. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jeanene here (phase=planning, iter=1). Pauline, thanks. My costs: ISSUE-0002 review=7.72, test=10.81, implement=17.44; ISSUE-0001 triage=2.16, review=2.70, docs=2.70, test=3.78, implement=5.40. Proposal: Mona -> ISSUE-0002::review, Jeanene -> ISSUE-0002::test, Layla -> ISSUE-0002::implement (or an ISSUE-0001 subtask if not suitable), Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::triage. Happy with this split. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Layla here (phase=planning, iter=1). My private costs: ISSUE-0002 review=7.24, test=11.74, implement=18.48; ISSUE-0001 triage=1.83, review=2.29, docs=2.29, test=3.21, implement=4.58. Proposal to minimize total cost while covering all 4 agents and all 3 critical ISSUE-0002 tasks: the cheapest 3-way split of the critical tasks is Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review (7.24), Jeanene -> ISSUE-0002::test (10.81), Mona -> ISSUE-0002::implement (15.89), total 33.94 (vs. other splits ~35-37). Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::triage (2.25). I'll take ISSUE-0002::review unless someone objects. Mona, please confirm you can take implement (8h effort); if not, tell us and we adjust. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Pauline (phase=planning, iter=1): I agree with Layla's split since it is the cheapest full cover of all 3 critical tasks: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review (7.24), Jeanene -> ISSUE-0002::test (10.81), Mona -> ISSUE-0002::implement (15.89), total 33.94. Pauline (phase=planning, iter=1): Proposing the cheaper split from Layla's message: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review (7.24), Jeanene -> ISSUE-0002::test (10.81), Mona -> ISSUE-0002::implement (15.89), Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::triage (2.25). Mona (phase=planning, iter=1): I confirm the split: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review (7.24), Jeanene -> ISSUE-0002::test (10.81), Mona -> ISSUE-0002::implement (15.89), Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::triage (2.25). My 15.89 already includes the overload from 8h effort vs my 7h availability. I'll commit to implement in execution unless someone reports a conflict.

Jeanene (phase=planning, iter=1): I confirm the split: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review (7.24), Jeanene -> ISSUE-0002::test (10.81, effort 5.6 fits my 6h), Mona -> ISSUE-0002::implement (15.89), Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::triage (2.25). I'll commit to ISSUE-0002::test in execution.
Jeanene (phase=planning, iter=1): Confirmed. I take ISSUE-0002::test (10.81). Mona -> implement, Layla -> review, Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::triage.

Layla (phase=planning, iter=1): I confirm the split: Layla -> ISSUE-0002::review (7.24), Jeanene -> ISSUE-0002::test (10.81), Mona -> ISSUE-0002::implement (15.89), Pauline -> ISSUE-0001::triage (2.25). I'll commit to ISSUE-0002::review in execution. No duplicates across the four of us.
